title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Fearing her hidden secret will be revealed, Vennila plans to kill Rajasekar. Later, Anbu and Sivagami are left shocked on hearing about Rajasekar's deadly accident.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman defends Kalamma before Kumaresan and apologises for slapping Siddharth. Later, Viji visits the temple with Ilamathi and admits feeling close to Paraman.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Manickam seeks the missing autopsy report while Vetri pleads with Sudar. Karna manipulates Swetha and hunts for clues about Abinaya's hidden daughter.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian catches Saravanan sleeping at work, raising Gomathi's concern. Meanwhile, Kathir and Raji reminisce about their past as newlyweds return home together.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: While the family enjoys watching TV, Chozhan secretly romances Nila. Meanwhile, Nadesan spots his ex-girlfriend at a food truck and later confides in Nila about the encounter.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu feels relieved after Meena's surgery succeeds. On hearing that Nachiyar has fainted, Annamalai visits her. Meanwhile, Devika urges Manoj to start his life with Kanaga.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Junior Singers enter an intense one-on-one battle round. Engaging games ignite every faceoff, and winners claim amazing gifts from the Gift Room in this thrilling competition.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: Cooks and Comalis gear up for the International Cuisine Battle with airport ticket pairings. The fun begins as they compete in the flower-shaped omelette advantage task.
